cfallin opened PR #15360 from cfallin:fix-15284 to bytecodealliance:main:

Fixes #15284.

  • Handle breakpoints set on modules that were never instantiated.
  • Handle "slipped" breakpoints (where actual breakpoint PC is slipped forward to the next program point) properly so, if added more than once, they can be removed.
  • Handle mem::forget(BreakpointState) leaving code unpublished (causing segfault on next attempt to run the Wasm code) by changing the editing API to take a closure instead; when the closure completes, we apply the batch of edits (or drop the batch if the closure returned an error).
